interface.title: Metadata schemas
interface.tagline: Find the right format. Start with a guide.
interface.lead: Public validation schemas, a JSON-LD context, and practical guides for metadata curators and developers.
interface.heading: Explore our metadata profiles
interface.description: Choose the format of your metadata file. Each guide explains the fields and shows how to process or validate a record.

igsn-core.title: IGSN Core XML
igsn-core.description: Describe physical samples with IGSN Core 2.0. Validate the XML metadata with the published XSD and its bundled dependencies.

datacite-json.title: DataCite JSON
datacite-json.description: Check DataCite 4.7 metadata attributes, required fields, and allowed values. For a JSON API document, select data.attributes before validation.

datacite-jsonld.title: DataCite JSON-LD
datacite-jsonld.description: Share DataCite metadata as Linked Data with the compact attrs/value profile. The context defines terms and their meaning. The guide explains the full validation workflow.

guidance.title: Choose a fixed revision for repeatable results
guidance.description: The current file URL follows the published revision. Use the fixed revision file to repeat the same validation or Linked Data processing. Each package includes a list of files and their checksums. Earlier revisions are available in the guides.

guidance.title: A context gives meaning to Linked Data
guidance.description: Processing a JSON-LD context maps terms to IRIs and defines value types and collections. It does not check required DataCite fields or cardinalities. Follow the JSON-LD guide to check the supported profile and converted attributes.

supporting.title: OAI-PMH / DCAT-AP RDF/XML envelope
supporting.description: This small XSD checks the RDF/XML envelope used to carry DCAT-AP records through OAI-PMH. It does not validate the DCAT-AP metadata model. RDF semantics and DCAT-AP constraints require separate SHACL validation.
